title: fix(app-shell): show the explain refusal's message instead of blanking the Access panel

_Requested by **Warren** · [project thread](https://claude.ai/code/project/chan_01U5RdnAAmkSQmZbqh6FtqZ8?thread=cmsg_01U5RdnAAmkSQmZbqh6FtqZ85kpgfqxzRKnovzXGcQbacp)_
Fixes #26805

Clause-②: no
Metadata-protocol: none

## 维护者速读

- **改了什么**:Studio「权限说明」面板在服务端返回非 403 拒绝时,改为读取错误信封里的 message 显示,而不是整个面板消失。
- **为什么改**:管理员把对象名打错(404)、参数不合法(400)或服务端出错(500)时,面板直接变空白、没有任何提示,无从下手。
- **风险与回滚**:风险低,只改一个面板的出错文案读取,复用已有的共享读取器;回滚即还原本 PR 的一个提交。
- **先看**:`AccessExplainPanel.tsx` 的 `if (!res.ok)` 分支与 `catch`;新测试 `AccessExplainPanel.refusalEnvelope-26805.test.tsx`。
- **两分钟验证**:`pnpm --dir ui exec vitest run packages/app-shell/src/views/metadata-admin/AccessExplainPanel.refusalEnvelope-26805.test.tsx`,预期 8 个用例全绿。
- **需要你做的**:无,席位落地。

## What changes

`AccessExplainPanel` (Studio Access pillar) built its failure text from `data.message || data.error`. The explain door refuses in the ADR-0112 envelope, `{ success: false, error: { code, message } }`, where `error` is an object: it reached `setError`, rendered as a React child and unmounted the sheet, so any non-403 refusal left a blank panel.

- The `!res.ok` branch now asks the shared app-shell reader `readEnvelopeFailureText` (`utils/apiErrorEnvelope.ts`) first, the same reader the package surfaces and the AI publish path use. ⛔ No new copy, and the shared reader is unchanged: it returns `null` for non-envelope bodies by design, and its header asks each caller to keep its own legacy rungs and fallback on its own line. So the panel keeps its two flat rungs (top-level `message`, bare-string `error`), now typed so only a string can pass, then the existing `HTTP STATUS STATUS_TEXT` line. This is the `PackagesPage` publish call site's spelling.
- The `catch` hands `setError` a string only: an `Error`'s non-empty message, otherwise `String(err)`. Before, a rejection whose `message` was not a string reached state as-is.
- The 403 branch is untouched: it still shows the localized delegated-scope sentence.
- No server change and no change to the explain request.

## Tests

New file `AccessExplainPanel.refusalEnvelope-26805.test.tsx` (8 cases), on the existing panel harness (faked authenticated fetch):

- nested envelope 404 `OBJECT_NOT_FOUND`, 400 `VALIDATION_FAILED`, 500 `INTERNAL_ERROR`: the alert carries the server message and code, never `[object Object]`, and the panel's form is still mounted;
- flat `{ message }` 404 still shows its message;
- non-JSON 500 falls back to `HTTP 500 Internal Server Error`;
- 403 in the nested envelope keeps the delegated-scope sentence;
- a rejected request shows its `Error` message; a non-`Error` rejection leaves the panel mounted with an alert.

## Acceptance notes

- The shared reader appends the declared code in parentheses (`Object 'x' not found (OBJECT_NOT_FOUND)`), as on every other surface that uses it.
- Seven pre-existing eslint warnings in `AccessExplainPanel.tsx` sit on lines this diff does not touch; none are added.
